newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Simsbury, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Simsbury, Conn..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Town of Simsbury, Connecticut, at Day, Berry & Howard, CityPlace I, 185 Asylum Street, Mark Twain Conference Room, 25th Floor, Hartford, Connecticut 06103, until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Standard Time) on for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of $5,000,000 General Obligation Bonds, Issue of 1997, payable on January 15 in each year as follows: $410,000 in the year 1998, $425,000 in the year 1999, $445,000 in the year 2000, $460,000 in the year 2001, $480,000 in the year 2002, $505,000 in the year 2003, $530,000 in the year 2004, $555,000 in the year 2005, $580,000 in the year 2006, and $610,000 in the year 2007.

The Bonds will be qualified tax-exempt obligations'', will be certified by Fleet National Bank, Hartford, Connecticut, and delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about February 4, 1997, subject to the approving opinion of Day, Berry & Howard of Hartford, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book- entry system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities depository.

Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the Town's Official Statement may be obtained from Ms. Christine M. Doyle, Senior Managing Consultant, at Public Financial Management, Inc., 99 Summer Street, Suite 1020, Boston, Massachusetts 02110-1240 (telephone (617) 330-6914).
